name: Bucatini with Mushrooms and Sausage
subtitle: Creamy porcini bucatini with browned sausage
description: Dried porcini, browned sausage, garlic, wine, and cream make a savory sauce for bucatini, finished with parsley, nutmeg, and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: sausages such as Italian or cumberland (if using cumberland
ingredients.preparation: add a pinch of fennel seeds to the meat while cooking)

ingredients.item: handful of flat-leaf parsley roughly chopped

instructions.text: Pour boiling water over the dried porcini mushrooms and set aside to soften. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Heat the olive oil in the skillet. Remove the sausage meat from its casings, if needed, and cook until lightly browned; if using cumberland sausages, add a pinch of fennel seeds while cooking.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the bucatini according to the package directions until al dente.
Add the garlic cloves sliced, chilli flakes, and white wine to the sausage. Drain and add the softened porcini, then cook until the wine has reduced slightly.
Stir in the double cream, grating of nutmeg, and half the handful of flat-leaf parsley roughly chopped. Simmer briefly, then add the drained bucatini and toss until coated.
Check that the sausage reaches 160°F in the thickest pieces. Serve with the remaining parsley and parmesan grated.
